description: Nothing added to holon-coherence may name the control-plane repository's task-tracking directory, its agent-instruction directory, its scratch directory or a four-digit task id, because such text ends up in the append-only intents ledger and in the repository history. Today only an agent remembering the rule keeps these out.
goal: Add a shared pattern module scripts/harness_reference_patterns.py, built from fragments so no source or test file contains a literal match of its own pattern, and a standalone script scripts/check_no_harness_references.py with a diff mode that scans the lines a pull request adds (base to head) and the pull request body for those patterns and fails closed when it cannot read the diff, and a tree mode that scans the current files and reports existing hits for clean-up. Run the diff mode from a new CI workflow .github/workflows/test-no-harness-references.yml on pull requests, passing the pull request body; do not edit any existing workflow. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Hand-kept rules slip; a CI scan that fails closed means no agent has to remember it.
acceptance_criteria: CI hygiene test scanning the PR diff (added lines) and PR body for the same patterns; fails closed: tests/test_check_no_harness_references.py proves scripts/check_no_harness_references.py fails on an added line and on a pull request body that carry a reference (built at run time from fragments, never written literally in the test file), passes on a clean diff and body, and fails closed when the diff is unreadable.

A one-off scan of current main reports existing hits for clean-up: the tree mode of scripts/check_no_harness_references.py lists every file and line that matches, and a test proves it on a temporary tree holding one reference.

scripts/harness_reference_patterns.py is the single source of the patterns; .github/workflows/test-no-harness-references.yml is new, runs the diff mode on pull requests and no existing workflow file is edited.
CI hygiene test scanning the PR diff (added lines) and PR body for the same patterns; fails closed.
A one-off scan of current main reports existing hits for clean-up.
The check runs automatically (pre-commit hook and/or CI, and the flow gate where it applies); no agent has to remember it.
The check is proven to fail on a real or reconstructed violation (a test with today's evidence) before it is trusted, and passes on the cleaned state.
Self-explaining code invariant in anything written: no docstrings, no comments except `# why:`.
Target-repository work goes through `holon flow`; the intent never names harness paths or bean ids.
Every new module is at most 200 lines; the module budget configuration is unchanged; the project's pytest and lint tasks pass.
